summary: 40-year-old Colorado man, experienced backcountry skier, found dead on a snowfield above Cony Lake in the Hutcheson Lakes drainage (~10 miles from nearest trailhead); reported overdue early Sunday after a planned Finch Lake hike and nearby snowfield ski; car found at Finch Lake trailhead; cause of death not yet determined
notes: NPS morning report (reported 2010-07-26): body found Sunday by rangers; recovery planned for the following day
